description: Fetch the publisher-pasted representative response for an API. This is what the publisher claims their API returns on a typical successful call. Compare against `gatefare.get_api`'s captured example (what we actually got from probing) to spot inconsistencies BEFORE you pay. Capped at 4 KiB UTF-8 by the platform. Returns null when the publisher has not provided a sample (older listings).
name: gatefare.sample_response
